environment.runtime: Optimized release macOS .app, WebKit at tauri://localhost, installed plugin Worker and native SQLite
environment.interaction: CUA native accessibility, keyboard, text drag and native open/save panels; no injected JavaScript or debug MCP
environment.buildCommand: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true bun run --filter @read-aware/desktop tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.capability-e2e.conf.json --config '{"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false,"fileAssociations":[]}}' --bundles app --no-sign --ci

annotations.navigationLimit: Target was also the last persisted location; does not independently prove navigation displaced a different reading position or cover other formats.

exports.validation: Ruby standard JSON and CSV parsers: body, quoted newline/comma/double quote, Unicode, ID and CFI match; CSV starts EF BB BF and body has leading apostrophe; JSON has original body and no revision.

automationCaveats: CUA typeText omitted the initial Chinese characters and macOS smart quotes changed ASCII quotes. Actual first persisted/exported data was inspected; the plugin form was then filled with paste, its exact value checked in AX and SQLite, and both final exports repeated. This is not evidence of an application Unicode loss.

Native Save As selection retained an extension while the test typed another, producing .json.json and .csv.csv in /tmp. Artifact copies above preserve file bytes. Do not silently normalize the path returned by the native save panel.
A stale CUA AX diff after navigation was refreshed by selecting the same owned app again; the new tree and screenshot showed the actual reader.
notVerified: Adversarial packaged CSP: direct messages, child Workers, dynamic modules, network or native API bypass; positive plugin execution is not isolation proof.
In-flight permission revocation, upgrade/rollback failures, zip and marketplace installs, other provider sessions.
Binary or streaming exports, disk failures, concurrent save dialogs, all-resource or frozen-snapshot exports.
Other formats, displacement from a different location, full keyboard/long-form focus and locale matrix.
Actual remote model behavior, all remaining Agent/plugin capabilities, W01-W32 completion.
